'''2006 World Championship Day 2 Greg Shaw DS Agents Of Black Sun''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Greg Shaw]] at [[2006 World Championship]] (Day 2); the list below is as posted on DeckTech by Greg "privateeye" Shaw (2006-11-03).<ref name="src">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/decks/decks.php?deck=35777 shaw hijacks chu/fred aobs]. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20071014025556/http://decktech.net:80/starwarsccg/decks/decks.php?deck=35777 Internet Archive]</ref>

'''Note:''' Stage: post says it went 3-0 on Day 2, but the closing note says Day 2 had grabber/bolt switched plus They're Still Coming Through x2 and Feltipern Trevagg's Stun Rifle (V), replaced by Sense x2 and Cold Feet (V) for Day 3; the list appears to be the Day 3 version.<ref name="src" />

== Original post ==

'''shaw hijacks chu/fred aobs'''
* '''Author:''' Greg "privateeye" Shaw
* '''Published:''' November 3, 2006
* '''Rating:''' 4.98
* '''Description:''' it chokes, it battles, it retrieves, it damages. it just wins.

=== Strategy ===

so this deck is the product of jonny chu and brian fred. i had the list for a few weeks before worlds. i never played a game with it until 2am before day 2. it went 3-0 for me in day 2 with wins over peter jacobsen (whap), brian fred (raider wys), and brian rippetoe (wys). and i am sure i wasn't playing it to its fullest potential. fred told me to post it, so here it is.

it chokes, it battles, it retrieves, it damages. it just wins.

there are soo many things you can do with this deck, it's astounding. influence pulls ket maliss who pulls a couple d:0 f:abunch guys and your docking bays. xizor pulls any red card so you can: get lando out asap, get mandolorian armor on xizor, get establish control v, get elis, whatever you need.

influence pulls vigos, the right guri for the right situation, the gemmep, broken jodo kast, the second xizor, whoever you want.

lando is key for hidden weapons and fett and overload. get him out fast.

guri v makes hidden base and other noninteractive games a breeze.

broken concentration lets you boost your differential and otherwise choke the opponent.

matchups upon request, stealtheblind on aim or over pm.

it's aobs. try to remember everything you can do.

good luck.

greg.
